$comment: Co-12 properties data for the Co-12 page. Edit this file to add/change the three dimensions (Content, Presentation, User), their properties, and descriptions.
intro: The Co-12 framework is an established set of twelve quality properties for evaluating explanations in Explainable AI. The properties are organised into three dimensions — Content, Presentation, and User. Each property below has a short description and a key idea. Click a property to reveal its description.

dimensions.label: Content
dimensions.description: Properties that describe what the explanation contains and how faithful it is to the model.

values.description: Describes how faithful the explanation is with respect to the black box.
Describes how much of the black box behaviour is described in the explanation.
Describes how deterministic and implementation-invariant the explanation method is.
values.keyIdea: Identical inputs should have identical explanations

values.description: Describes how continuous and generalizable the explanation function is.
values.keyIdea: Similar inputs should have similar explanations

values.description: Describes how discriminative the explanation is with respect to other events or targets.
Describes how complex the (interactions of) features in the explanation are.

dimensions.label: Presentation
dimensions.description: Properties that describe how the explanation is presented and formatted.

values.description: Describes the size of the explanation.
Describes the presentation format and organization of the explanation.
Describes the presence and accuracy of probability information in the explanation.
values.keyIdea: Confidence measure of the explanation or model output

dimensions.label: User
dimensions.description: Properties that describe how the explanation relates to the user and their needs.

values.description: Describes how relevant the explanation is to the user and their needs.
values.keyIdea: How much does the explanation matter in practice?

values.description: Describes how accordant the explanation is with prior knowledge and beliefs.
Describes how interactive or controllable an explanation is for a user.
values.keyIdea: Can the user influence the explanation?
